title: Zwölfjährige bei Unfall mit E-Scooter verletzt

extraction.summaryEn: A car collided with an e-scooter at a crossing in Niederschönhausen, throwing its two riders onto the pavement. A 12-year-old girl was hospitalised and her 38-year-old mother was treated as an outpatient; the 73-year-old driver was unhurt.
